mapper.insert: insert into feedback ( file_id, overall_score, overall_comment, job_fit_score, job_fit_comment, logic_score, logic_comment, writing_score, writing_comment, typo_score, typo_comment ) values ( #{fileId}, #{overallScore}, #{overallComment}, #{jobFitScore}, #{jobFitComment}, #{logicScore}, #{logicComment}, #{writingScore}, #{writingComment}, #{typoScore}, #{typoComment} )
mapper.select: select feedback_id, file_id, overall_score, overall_comment, job_fit_score, job_fit_comment, logic_score, logic_comment, writing_score, writing_comment, typo_score, typo_comment, created_at from feedback where file_id = #{fileId}
